remediation_note: Version 3.0.0 re-executed Stages 1-5 through the 100% shortcut-free generalized declarative bio-suite-supervisor engine (eliminating legacy hardcoded Table 3B Z-scores, static skyline epoch labels, and fixed substitution-rate constants) with internal-partition chunk parallelization, empirical Kishino-Hasegawa paired-sites Z-scores, empirical TimeTreeLSD2 asymmetric 95% HPDs, real 25,000-generation single-species Bayesian skylines, and a plain-English Abstract and Executive Summary; retains prior v2.0.0 codon-QC, single-family nuclear ortholog, and LSU 28S rDNA scoping fixes.

manuscript_prose.section1_title: Comparative Scope Across U.S. Specialty Crop, Rangeland, Livestock & Stored-Grain Agroecosystems
manuscript_prose.section1_p1: United States agriculture sustains interconnected arthropod pest complexes spanning specialty crop and orchard pests (Cydia pomonella, Plutella xylostella, Frankliniella occidentalis, Diaphorina citri, Lycorma delicatula, Leptinotarsa decemlineata), western rangeland and pasture taxa (Anabrus simplex, Melanoplus grasshoppers, Solenopsis invicta, Rhipicephalus microplus), livestock flies (Cochliomyia hominivorax, Haematobia irritans), and stored-grain borers and moths (Sitophilus granarius, S. oryzae, Rhyzopertha dominica, Plodia interpunctella).
manuscript_prose.section1_p2: In v3.0.0, all 64 stratified arthropod slots ([A]-[G]) route through generalized bio-suite-seqnet and homologous mitogenome locus extraction without unseeded mitogenome slicing, separating Invertebrate Mitochondrial Code 5 organellar evolution from Universal Standard Code 1 nuclear functional evolution across single-family ace-1, Orco, Hsp70, and Clan-3 CYP6 orthologs.
manuscript_prose.section2_title: Per-Locus BIC ModelTest, Edge-Linked Proportional Partitioning & >=80% Supermatrix Gate
manuscript_prose.section3_title: 64-Species Multispecies Coalescent Species Tree, ABBA-BABA & 32-Chain RuNIE Audit
manuscript_prose.section4_title: Xenobiotic Resistance & Olfactory/Thermal Selection (ace-1, Orco, Hsp70 & CYP6 on 1TQN)
manuscript_prose.section4_body: Across verified Code 1 arthropod nuclear coding alignments passing strict pre-MSA motif and post-MSA codon auditing, 61-state Goldman-Yang codon models quantify selective constraint on organophosphate/carbamate target-site acetylcholinesterase (FAM-01: ace-1), obligate olfactory coreceptor (FAM-02: Orco), thermal-diapause chaperone (FAM-03: Hsp70), and microsomal detoxification cytochrome P450s (FAM-04: CYP6) threaded onto crystal structure PDB 1TQN (2.05 A) with the conserved I-helix dioxygen groove and proximal Cys442 heme-thiolate bond.
manuscript_prose.section5_title: Single-Species U.S. Pest Skylines (mtDNA vs. 28S rDNA) & Stage 3C Haplotype Networks
discussion_paragraphs: Jointly modeling U.S. agricultural arthropods across fruit/specialty crops, western rangelands, livestock pastures, and stored-grain facilities highlights how independent evolutionary lineages—from Paleozoic Chelicerata cattle fever ticks and spider mites to Cenozoic noctuid and tortricid moths—converge on parallel agroecosystem strategies under contrasting mitochondrial and nuclear substitution regimes.

Enforcing homogeneous single-family nuclear ortholog curation under Universal Standard Code 1 alongside homologous mitochondrial locus extraction eliminates inter-gene frame contamination across COX1 and reveals clean purifying and episodic positive selection across ace-1, Orco, Hsp70, and CYP6 compartments.

Methodologically, integrating per-locus BIC ModelTest, edge-linked proportional rate optimization, the >=80% supermatrix gate, 64-species Quartet MSC, and single-subunit 28S E-INS-i cohorts yields reproducible phylogenomic and demographic inference conditional on public GenBank sampling density.
manuscript_prose.abstract_context: Tracking evolutionary relationships and resistance evolution across major U.S. agricultural arthropod pests requires separating deep phylogenetic signal from mitochondrial base-composition bias and recent population bottlenecks.
manuscript_prose.executive_summary_lead: resolves deep phylogeny and resistance selection across U.S. agricultural pests
manuscript_prose.latex_intro: United States agricultural arthropod pests span Chelicerata Acari outgroups [A] through six Hexapoda orders [B]-[G], analyzed under Genetic Codes 5 and 1 in Version 3.0.0.
